description: Remove the password from a PDF you already know the password for. This decrypts with the supplied password; it does not break or guess encryption. The input is uploaded to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and not stored. The result is written to output_path, replacing any file already there, and the call returns that path and the size in bytes. Inputs are limited to 50 MB, and each call counts as one operation against the daily quota.

file.description: Absolute path to the password-protected PDF.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: unlock_pdf
